scope: Hoist total typed parameter resource samples to their proven query/target or loop scope. Split a uniform gradient/curve sample from varying scaling/clamping with existing instructions; preserve the fused gradient operation's explicit 0..1 gain clamp. No runtime interpreter change, opcode, format change or retained frame cache. Pointwise program fusion remains unfinished.
method: ESP32 rev3.1, 240 MHz, one core, Wi-Fi off, GPIO untouched. Cargo release opt-level 3, fat LTO, one codegen unit. One profiling ELF runs 18 current workloads and seven previous prepared-binding archives. Each timing window includes 32 frames and first use. Two-second controls bracket 997/1999 us PC sampling. Instruction instrumentation is removed before building the device image. Excludes network, storage, DMA and physical output; no laptop timing comparison.
baseline: 2026-10-03-prepared-bindings.json; seven preceding archives are rerun in this same image.

correctness.focused_tests: 125 runtime unit tests pass. New cases compare split sampling against independent sampling math across empty curves/gradients, invalid clamp bounds, gains above one, missing values, branches, block tails and seeks. Target-dependent resource samples refresh when bounds change. Existing temporal, automation and scalar/block parity tests pass.

validation: cargo fmt and the complete pnpm check pass, including 125 runtime unit tests, 11 allocation tests, 16 device-storage tests and warning-denying workspace Clippy. Complete controller release image builds and is byte-for-byte unchanged. Nine measured source hashes match the checkout. Desktop watcher test passed.

mixed_memory_before_after.note: Separate sampling and scaling adds 50 wire bytes and 56 decoded bytes. Workspace allocation does not grow. The other six controlled comparisons retain unchanged memory.

mixed_instruction_counts_per_frame_befor.note: Dispatch count rises by 450 because the split gradient needs a separate clamp and scale. Lifted resource instructions execute in single-lane initialization; their previous numeric-body dispatch performed sampling for each lane. Dispatch counts therefore do not measure the arithmetic removed.

hotspot_percent_before_after.note: Weighted self-symbol shares across two sampling periods in the same ELF. These are sampling estimates, not isolated costs; the shared VM symbol does not distinguish effects from operators. Stanford remains about 59.2% VM and 21.8% software float division.

limits: Mixed frame time falls 5.2%, ScanSweep and Impact about 14%, Sparkle about 17%. Mixed still misses all 32 60 Hz deadlines and is 2.47x faster than the earlier 291705 us staged/block baseline, not 5x. Stanford fits the measured evaluation deadlines. Shimmer 1200 still lacks sufficient 60 Hz headroom. No broader gain is claimed for unchanged workloads.
raw_evidence: Ignored target/vm-opt-20261002/uniform-samples contains cases, verified device capture, PC attribution, instruction counts, source hashes and build logs. The full gate log is target/vm-opt-20261002/uniform-samples-full-check.log. Only this reviewed summary is retained outside target.
